candidates.title: eLLM: Elastic Memory Management Framework for Efficient LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Virtual Tensor abstractionとOS ballooning型elastic GPU memory poolでruntime memoryとKV cacheを統合管理。decode throughput 2.32x、128K inputでbatch size 3xを報告。

candidates.title: PAM: Processing Across Memory Hierarchy for Efficient KV-centric LLM Serving System
candidates.reason: 複数の異種PIM-enabled memory tierへKVを配置し、attention計算・KV migration・online schedulingをmemory hierarchy全体で協調するKV-centric serving system。

candidates.title: Astrolabe: Balancing Load in LLM Serving with Randomized Prediction-Guided Scheduling
candidates.reason: response-length estimationとper-instance latency simulation、power-of-two choicesでmigrationなしのmulti-instance dispatchを行うscheduler。P99 TTFT最大77%削減。
